blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) language-model training can exhibit large loss spikes with Muon-family optimizers. We introduce EnergyCal, a lightweight rule that attenuates routed-expert updates according to the normalized squared Frobenius norm of their finite-step Newton-Schulz directions. EnergyCal leaves the spectral transform unchanged and adds no persistent optimizer state. We evaluate it on a 4B-parameter MoE model. Against a development-selected, lower-learning-rate MuonH recipe, EnergyCal-MuonH reduces mean thresholded loss-spike burden by 99.51% and final geometric-mean perplexity by 4.06%, with a modest throughput cost. With plain Muon at matched nominal learning rate and weight decay, the reduction in mean spike burden averages 95.98% across the two tested exponents, accompanied by small endpoint improvements. These findings support stabilization both with and without Hyperball in the evaluated setting.

blocks.en:
Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models route tokens unevenly across experts, creating time-varying optimization conditions [ 1 ] .
This setting can be challenging for Muon-family optimizers, which use Newton–Schulz (NS) iterations to transform momentum-based updates.
Muon has shown promise for language-model pretraining [ 2 , 3 , 4 ] , while Hyperball introduces explicit control over weight and update norms [ 5 ] .
Its Muon variant, MuonH, normalizes update directions and projects weights onto a fixed-radius sphere. In our custom 4B-parameter DeepSeekMoE-style model, both Muon and MuonH exhibit intermittent loss spikes, although all full-schedule runs complete.
We investigate whether these loss excursions can be mitigated through a simple modification of routed-expert updates.
blocks.zh:
Sparse 混合型专家(MoE)语言模型路由符号在专家之间不均匀,创造了时间变化的优化条件[1].
这种设置对于Muon-family优化者来说可能具有挑战性,他们使用Newton–Schulz(NS)迭代来改变基于动力的更新.
穆恩对语言模型预训[2,3,4]表现出承诺,而Hyperball引入了对重量的明确控制并更新规范[5].
它的Muon变体,MuonH,使方向的更新正常化,项目在固定射线球上加权. 在我们的定制的4B参数DeepSeekMoE型模型中,穆恩和穆恩H都表现出间歇性的损失尖峰,尽管全部全程运行完成.
我们调查是否可以通过简单的修改路径专家更新来减轻这些损失。

blocks.en:
An expert can retain nonzero momentum even when no tokens are assigned to it in the current step.
This motivates examining expert-wise update magnitudes, particularly under MuonH’s fixed-norm normalization.
We propose EnergyCal, a lightweight rule that attenuates each routed-expert update according to the normalized squared Frobenius norm of its finite-step NS direction.
Figure 1 illustrates the method.
The coefficient is bounded between zero and one and is applied continuously during training.
EnergyCal leaves the NS transform, momentum, and router objective unchanged, requires no token-utilization statistics, and adds no persistent optimizer state.
Its energy statistic is not scale-invariant stable rank: low energy can reflect direction concentration, amplitude, or both.

它的能量统计不是尺度-变量稳定排列:低能量可以反映方向浓度,振幅,或者两者兼而有之.

blocks.en:
We evaluate EnergyCal in two separate full-schedule studies, each using three initialization seeds.
First, a frozen EnergyCal–MuonH recipe reduces mean thresholded loss-spike burden by 99.51% and final geometric-mean perplexity by 4.06% relative to a development-selected, lower-learning-rate MuonH recipe, with 1.62% lower mean throughput.
Second, applying EnergyCal to plain Muon at matched nominal learning rate and weight decay reduces mean spike burden by 95.98% on average across the two tested exponents, with small endpoint improvements.
Together, these results show that stabilization is observed both with and without Hyperball in the evaluated MoE setting. However, plain Muon retains intermediate-quality and speed advantages in the first study, and different evaluation banks prevent a direct ranking of the calibrated optimizer families.
blocks.zh:
我们通过两个单独的全程研究来评价EnergyCal,每个研究都使用三个初始化种子.
首先,冷冻的EnergyCal-MuonH配方比开发选择的、学习率低的MuonH配方减少99.51%的临界亏损率和4.06%的几何-平均值,平均吞吐量减少1.62%。
第二,将EnergyCal应用到平原的Muon,按相应的名义学习率和体重衰减,平均将两个受测试的参与者的平均升降负担减少95.98%,并有小的终点改进。
这些结果表明,在评估的教育部环境中,无论有无Hyperball,都观察到稳定。 然而,Plain Muon在第一次研究中保留了中等质量和速度优势,不同的评价银行阻止了校准优化型家庭的直接排名.

blocks.en:
Our contribution is an empirical evaluation of one-sided, post-NS energy attenuation across MuonH and plain Muon.
Unlike utilization- or alignment-guided expert scaling methods [ 6 , 7 ] , EnergyCal relies only on the energy of each logical matrix’s NS direction.
The results do not establish general optimizer superiority or identify the cause of individual spikes: single-update interventions fail to rescue two examined events, and the plain-Muon study lacks a routed-only uniform-scaling control to separate energy-dependent attenuation from a simpler reduction in update magnitude.
We therefore focus on the measured stability benefits and their practical trade-offs within the tested setting; Section 7 discusses these evidence boundaries.

因此,我们注重在试验环境下衡量的稳定效益及其实际权衡;第7节讨论了这些证据界限。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Muon-family optimization and Hyperball. Muon applies a short Newton–Schulz (NS) iteration to momentum-based matrix updates [ 2 ] . Large-scale studies identify weight decay and update scaling as important for Muon pretraining [ 4 ] . Our plain-Muon baseline uses a shape factor of one rather than the full Moonlight recipe. Hyperball controls update and weight radii; its Muon variant, MuonH, normalizes trial directions and projects weights onto a fixed-radius sphere [ 5 ] . EnergyCal changes routed-expert step magnitudes after NS without changing the spectral transform.
blocks.zh: 木翁家族优化与超球. Muon将一个简短的牛顿–Schulz(NS)迭代应用于基于动力的矩阵更新[2]. 大规模研究确定重量衰减和更新规模对于穆恩预训很重要[4]. 我们的平原木基线使用一个形状系数,而不是完整的月光食谱。 Hyperball控制更新和重量光度;它的Muon变体,MuonH,使试验方向和项目在固定光度球场上的权重正常化[5]. 能源 Cal在NS之后改变路由-专家步数,而不改变光谱转换.

blocks.en: Expert-wise update scaling. Existing methods scale expert updates using other signals. Excitation uses expert utilization [ 6 ] , while ExpertMuon-Compass uses post-orthogonalization gradient alignment across experts and rows [ 7 ] . EnergyCal instead computes an independent coefficient q ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] q\in[0,1] from each routed matrix’s normalized squared post-NS Frobenius norm, without utilization inputs or cross-expert normalization. For q > 0 q>0 , scalar scaling preserves the NS direction; when q = 0 q=0 , the directional trial vanishes. Neither case guarantees the direction of the stored parameter displacement after Hyperball projection or low-precision writeback. Direction preservation itself is not unique to EnergyCal.

blocks.en: Magnitude and spectral corrections. NorMuon uses neuron-level normalization after orthogonalization [ 8 ] , and TrasMuon uses RMS calibration and energy-based clipping [ 9 ] . Thus, energy-aware scaling is not new by itself. Pion changes NS iterations [ 10 ] , while SoftMuon uses smooth spectral relaxation [ 11 ] . EnergyCal instead applies a matrix-level scalar after the unchanged NS transform. We do not report native-method head-to-head comparisons with these alternatives.
blocks.zh: 宽度和光谱校正。 NorMuon在正交化后使用神经元水平正常化[8],TrasMuon则使用RMS校准和以能量为基础的剪辑[9]. 因此,提高能源意识本身并不是新的。 Pion会改变NS迭代[10],而SoftMuon则使用光谱光滑放松[11]. 能源 Cal转而在不变的NS变换后应用矩阵级scalar. 我们不报告当地方法与这些替代品的正面比较。

blocks.en:
Training stability in sparse models. Training instability in sparse MoE models has motivated router-centered approaches, including ST-MoE’s router z-loss and methods for reducing routing fluctuations [ 12 , 13 ] .
Spike-aware optimization has also been studied in dense language-model training through momentum resets and gradient clipping [ 14 ] .
Unlike these approaches, EnergyCal attenuates routed-expert updates using post-NS direction energy without modifying routing objectives or introducing spike-triggered interventions.
blocks.zh:
在稀少的模型中培训稳定性。 零星的MOE模型中的培训不稳定性激发了路由器-以路由器为中心的方法,包括ST-MoE的路由器 z-损失和减少路由波动的方法[12,13].
Spike-aware优化也在密集的语言模型训练中通过动力重排和梯度剪切研究[14].
与这些方法不同的是,EnergyCal在不修改路线目标或采用突起式干预措施的情况下,利用NS后方向能量来削弱路由式专家更新。

blocks.en:
Finite-step orthogonalization. Recent analyses characterize the convergence and spectral behavior of Muon with finite-step Newton–Schulz iterations [ 15 , 16 ] .
MuonEq further investigates pre-NS equilibration to improve the geometry of orthogonalized updates [ 17 ] .
EnergyCal instead leaves the NS transform unchanged and applies a matrix-level attenuation coefficient to its returned direction.
blocks.zh:
有限步骤正交化. 最近的分析将穆恩的趋同和光谱行为定性为有限度步骤的牛顿-舒尔茨迭代[15,16].
MuonEq进一步调查了NS前的均衡,以改善正交化更新的几何学 [17].
EnergyCal则使NS变换保持不变,并将矩阵级的衰减系数用于返回方向。

blocks.en: Evaluation and optimizer comparisons. Optimizer rankings depend on tuning and training budget [ 18 ] ; angular effective learning rates also complicate the interpretation of Hyperball’s nominal learning rate [ 19 ] . We therefore report final quality, intermediate quality, loss-spike burden, and throughput separately. Matched nominal learning rate does not imply matched parameter movement, and fixed-token quality is distinct from equal-wall-time quality.
blocks.zh: 评价和优化比较。 优化排名取决于调校和培训预算[18];角有效学习率也使解释Hyperball名义学习率[19]复杂化. 因此,我们分别报告最终质量、中间质量、损失和消耗量。 匹配的名义学习率并不意味着匹配的参数运动,而固定键质量不同于平等壁时间质量.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Protocol

blocks.en: 4.1 Model, data, and training setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 模式、数据和培训设置

blocks.en: We train a custom 4B-parameter DeepSeekMoE-style language model from scratch, with 24 layers, hidden width 1,536, 128 routed experts of width 256 and top-2 routing, and one shared expert per layer. Its input and output embeddings are tied. The routed/shared design follows DeepSeekMoE [ 20 ] , with a separate traffic-driven router-bias controller [ 21 , 22 ] . Neither mechanism enters EnergyCal’s coefficient.
blocks.zh: 我们从零开始训练一种自定义的4B参数DeepSeekMoE型语言模型,有24层,隐藏宽度1 536,128个路由专家,宽度256和顶-2路由,每层共有一名专家. 它的输入和输出嵌入是绑定的. 路由/共享设计遵循DeepSeekMoE [20],另设交通驱动路由器-bias控制器[21,22]. EnergyCal 的系数为两个机制。

blocks.en: Each run uses eight H100 80GB GPUs, 2,048-token sequences, and 131,072 tokens per optimizer update. A complete run has 10,000 updates (1.31B tokens), with 500 warmup updates followed by cosine decay to 10% of peak learning rate. All methods use gradient clipping at norm 1, five NS iterations, and the same logical matrix partitions. These experiments do not claim compute-optimal or fully converged pretraining. Appendix A gives the relevant implementation details.
blocks.zh: 每次运行使用8台H100 80GB GPU,2,048个托肯序列,每个优化器更新131,072个令牌. 一次完全运行有10,000个更新(1.31B令牌),500个热量更新之后,余弦衰减到峰值学习率的10%. 所有方法都使用规范1,5NS迭代的梯度剪切,以及相同的逻辑矩阵分区. 这些实验并不主张计算最佳或完全汇合的预训. 附 录 A提供了相关的实施细节。

blocks.en: Training uses FineWeb sample-10BT [ 23 ] , with a deterministic train/validation partition. All final runs share the same data order; the independently varied initialization seeds do not constitute independently sampled corpora. Validation uses a fixed 524,288-token bank evaluated every 500 updates. Banks are fixed within each comparison but differ between development, Cohort H, and Cohort M. They are not certified previously unused external test sets across the complete exploratory history.
blocks.zh: 训练使用FineWeb采样-10BT [23],设有定型列车/验证分区. 所有最终运行都共享相同的数据顺序;独立多样的初始化种子不构成独立采样的蝎子. 验证使用固定的524,288托肯银行,每500个更新一次评价. 银行在每次比较中都是固定的,但发展、Cohort H和Cohort M之间有所不同。 在整个探索史上,这些测试没有经过核证。

blocks.en: Development screening evaluates the MuonH and plain-Muon learning-rate candidates over two initialization runs, using 3,000 updates of the 10,000-update schedule. Each baseline is selected by mean screening-endpoint validation cross-entropy (CE), not spike frequency. Both selected learning rates are 0.005, at the lower boundaries of their respective bounded search grids. The EnergyCal–MuonH recipe remains fixed at LR 0.01 and p = 1 p=1 ; its settings are not reselected using confirmation outcomes.

blocks.en:
We examine two baseline-scout loss excursions, events A and B. For each, candidate routed-down matrices were selected using low stable rank and traffic-weighted projected operator displacement, with same-bank controls. The heuristic was devised from exploratory captures but fixed before intervention outcomes. Seven branches per event modify one optimizer update and then return to the canonical training procedure (Appendix D ).
These events were selected for diagnostic analysis and should not be treated as representative samples of loss spikes.

blocks.en: 7 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 讨论和限制

blocks.en:
Empirical contribution and practical trade-offs. The main finding is a substantial reduction in thresholded loss-spike burden with both MuonH and plain Muon, accompanied by small improvements in final validation quality.
In Cohort H, the frozen EnergyCal–MuonH recipe reduces mean burden by 99.51% relative to a development-selected, lower-rate MuonH recipe, with improved endpoint quality and 1.62% lower mean
throughput.
Because the learning rates differ, this comparison does not isolate the effect of calibration alone.
The plain-Muon comparator is faster and achieves better intermediate quality; an illustrative equal-time estimate can also favor plain Muon.
In Cohort M, EnergyCal reduces mean burden by 95.98% on average across two tested exponents at matched nominal learning rate and weight decay, showing that stabilization is also observed without Hyperball.
However, different validation banks preclude a direct quality ranking of the calibrated optimizer families, and no production-style throughput benchmark is available for Cohort M.
These results support empirical stabilization in the evaluated setting, not general optimizer superiority.
blocks.zh:
经验贡献与实际权衡. 主要结论是MuonH和Plain Muon的阈值损失spike负担大幅减少,同时最终审定质量也略有改善。
在Cohort H中,冷冻的EnergyCal-MuonH配方相对于开发选择的较低速率的MuonH配方,平均负担减少了99.51%,端点质量得到改善,平均重量降低了1.62%.
吞吐量。
由于学习率不同,这种比较并不单独孤立校准的效果.
Plain-Muon比较器更快,并且能达到更好的中间质量;一个说明性的平时估计也可以有利于Plain Muon.
在Cohort M中,EnergyCal以相应的名义学习率和体重衰减率平均将两个被测试的实验者的平均负担减少95.98%,表明没有Hyperball也能观察到稳定.
然而,不同的验证银行排除了校准优化型家庭的直接质量排名,而Cohort M没有生产风格的吞吐量基准.
这些结果有助于在评价环境中实现经验稳定,而不是一般的优化优势。

blocks.en:
The unresolved uniform-scaling alternative. EnergyCal attenuates routed-expert updates, but the observed improvements need not arise specifically from assigning different coefficients according to direction energy.
Cohort M lacks a routed-only uniform-scaling or update-budget-matched control, so it cannot distinguish energy-dependent attenuation from the benefit of reducing routed-update magnitudes more generally.
A fixed coefficient near 0.96, leaving weight decay and non-routed updates unchanged, would provide an informative comparison, although it would not exactly match the update-norm budget.
Appendix C.3 distinguishes these controls.
Furthermore, we do not establish relative superiority over other expert-wise scaling methods, including Compass and Excitation, because native-method head-to-head comparisons were not performed.
blocks.zh:
尚未解决的统一尺度办法。 能源 计算削弱路由专家的更新,但观察到的改进不必具体来自根据方向能量分配不同的系数。
组合 M缺乏只有路由的统一缩放或更新预算匹配的控制,因此无法将依赖能量的衰减与更普遍地减少路由更新数量的好处区分开来。
固定系数接近0.96,使重量衰减和非例行更新保持不变,将提供一个信息性比较,尽管它并不完全符合更新与规范的预算。
附录C.3区分了这些控制措施。
此外,我们没有确定与其他专家衡量方法相比的相对优越性,包括Compass和Extriction,因为没有进行土生土长的方法头对头比较。

blocks.en:
Geometry and causal interpretation. The geometric analysis provides motivation for attenuation, not a causal explanation of loss spikes.
The inverse-stable-rank identity describes the operator norm of MuonH’s trial update, not the final projected or stored parameter displacement, and does not directly apply to plain Muon.
Moreover, the energy statistic depends on both spectral concentration and direction amplitude, rather than stable rank alone.
In two examined events, single-update interventions substantially reduce the nominated parameter movements but fail to prevent the subsequent loss spikes.
Thus, the full-schedule benefits cannot be explained simply as immediate removal of these two events through one-step attenuation.
Effects accumulated over training, including changes in expert parameters or routing dynamics, remain possible explanations but are not established here.
These negative interventions limit the mechanistic interpretation without negating the observed benefits of continuous calibration.
blocks.zh:
几何学与因果解释. 几何分析提供了减弱的动机,而不是损失尖锐的因果关系。
反向平稳身份描述了MuonH试验更新的操作规范,而不是最终预测或存储的参数置换,并不直接适用于Plain Muon.
此外,能量统计取决于光谱浓度和方向振幅,而不是单靠稳定的排名。
在两个受审查的事件中,一次性更新的干预措施大大减少了指定的参数移动,但未能防止随后的损失激增。
因此,不能简单地将全程效益解释为通过一步的缓解立即消除这两个事件。
对培训所积累的影响,包括专家参数或路径动态的变化,仍然是可能的解释,但在此没有确定。
这些负面干预限制了机械化解释,没有否认观察到的持续校准的好处.

blocks.en:
Scope, measurement, and generalizability. Both cohorts use one custom 4B-parameter, 128-expert, top-2 MoE model and 1.31B training tokens per run, with three initialization seeds and a shared data order.
The results therefore do not establish generalization across architectures, scales, data distributions, or training budgets.
Cohort H selects baselines within bounded learning-rate grids whose best-tested values lie at the lower boundaries; Cohort M fixes the plain-Muon recipe rather than independently retuning every variant.
Reported standard deviations describe run-to-run variation, not confidence intervals. The adaptive spike detector can miss persistent loss elevation, while periodic validation may miss transient quality changes.
Selected spectral measurements are not an all-layer census, and the local probes omit the subsequent router-bias-controller update.
blocks.zh:
范围、衡量和通用性。 两组均使用1个定制的4B参数,128位专家,顶级2个MOE模型和每跑1.31B训练符,并有3个初始化种子和共享数据顺序.
因此,这些结果没有在结构、尺度、数据分配或培训预算方面确立通用。
组合 H在极限学习速率网格内选择基线,其经测试的最佳值位于下界; Cohort M 修补平原-Muon配方,而不是独立地重新调整每个变体.
报告的标准偏差描述的是运行到运行的变异,而不是置信间隔. 适应性尖峰探测器可能错过持续损失的高度,而定期验证可能错过瞬态质量变化。
所选光谱测量不是全层普查,局部探测器省略了之后的路由器-比亚斯控制器更新.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en:
EnergyCal applies a simple, one-sided attenuation to routed-expert updates using finite-step Newton–Schulz direction energy.
In a 4B-parameter sparse MoE model, it substantially reduces thresholded loss-spike burden with both MuonH and plain Muon, showing that stabilization is also observed without Hyperball in the evaluated setting.
The frozen EnergyCal–MuonH recipe reduces mean burden by 99.51% and final geometric-mean perplexity by 4.06% relative to a development-selected, lower-rate MuonH recipe, with 1.62% lower mean throughput.
In a separate plain-Muon study at matched nominal learning rate and weight decay, reductions in mean burden average 95.98% across the two tested exponents, with small endpoint gains.
These results support empirical stabilization in the evaluated MoE setting rather than general optimizer superiority.
However, single-update interventions did not rescue two examined spikes, and the absence of a routed-only uniform-scaling control leaves the specific contribution of energy-dependent attenuation unresolved.
Further controlled comparisons are needed to distinguish this contribution from reduced update magnitude.
blocks.zh:
EnergyCal使用有限步骤牛顿-舒尔兹方向能量对路由-专家更新应用简单,单面的减速.
在4B参数的稀疏的MOE模型中,它与MuonH和Plain Muon都大大降低了阈值损失spike负载,表明在评估的环境下也观察到了稳定,没有Hyperball.
冷冻的EnergyCal-MuonH配方比开发选择的低速量的MuonH配方减少平均负担99.51%,最终几何-平均偏差减少4.06%,平均吞吐量减少1.62%。
在以相应的名义学习率和体重衰减率进行的一项单独的平庸-穆恩研究中,两个接受测试的参与者的平均负担平均减少95.98%,最终收益很小。
这些成果有助于在所评价的教育部设置中实现经验稳定,而不是总体优化优势。
然而,单一更新的干预措施并不能挽救两个经过检查的峰值,而缺乏一个仅经过路由的统一缩放控制,使得依赖能源的减弱的具体贡献得不到解决。
需要进一步进行有控制的比较,以区分这种贡献与减少的更新规模。

blocks.en: A fixed 512-token probe compares CE and output KL immediately before and after each treated update. They also do not negate the full-schedule improvement under continuous EnergyCal.
